column1: # Direct-spec corpus for refine-loop mode only (tools/corpus/refine-loop.mjs).
# Not read by run.mjs's quick/sweep/estates/conformance modes and not gated by
# any of their baselines — this file exists solely to give the refine-loop
# routing-accuracy ratchet at least one row with real signal.
# Every row of estates.tsv imports through `anvil estate import` with ZERO
# approved operations (route-only fidelity — see README.md's Refine-loop mode
# section), so the routing benchmark has nothing to route there and every
# catalog's accuracy records 0/0. A row here instead names a bare API contract
# (not a gateway archive) plus a supplemental Anvil manifest that approves a
# few of its read operations, and refine-loop.mjs compiles it directly via
# `anvil compile <spec> --manifest <manifest>` (see compileSpecRow in
# refine-loop.mjs) rather than `anvil estate import`. Everything downstream —
# refine run, `benchmark --catalog both`, clusters, export-task, the ratchet —
# is exactly the same pipeline gateway rows go through.
# Columns are TAB-separated:
#   name<TAB>vendor<TAB>spec<TAB>manifest
# `spec` and `manifest` are repo-relative. The manifest is scoped to this
# corpus lane only (see its own header) and never approves a mutation — it
# exists to feed the ratchet, not to grant new authority.
payments-approved
